The '''Liana Liberators''' were a group of [[Slicer/Legends|slicers]] who operated during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==History==
The group met at the [[University of Liana]] and consisted of three [[Gender/Legends|male]] and two female [[Human/Legends|Humans]]. They were anarchists and wanted to highlight the failings of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] to the rest of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], by slicing into Republic systems. However, during the Clone Wars they became involved in industrial espionage and undermining the Republic war effort, which resulted in them being actively sought by Republic agents and also the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Shiana Trist]].<ref name="TR">{{LivingForce|The Replacements}}</ref>

They traveled to the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]], where they hired the use of the [[Yacht/Legends|yacht]] ''[[Perihelion]]'' from [[Cularin Star Tours]] by posing as members of the [[Alderaanian Biological Research Institute]] and taking up the identities of [[P. Dantari]], [[K. Antilles]], [[H. Starfinder]], [[T. Orini]] and [[L. Raine]]. They planned to target the Cularin Government and the [[Almas Academy]] for illicit data to steal. However, the yacht was attacked by [[Mynock/Legends|mynocks]] and the Liberators called the CST safety ship ''[[Starchaser IV]]'' for help. It rescued them and left them none the wiser to their true identities. The Liberators then made their way to [[CMC-3]], an old mining facility in the [[Cularin asteroid belt]]. Shiana Trist informed the ''Starchaser'' of the Liberators presence and they tracked them to facility, where a battle broke out between them and the ''Perihelion''. The Liberators had also reactivated some of the facility's systems, including a powerful cutting beam and [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beam]], to help them in their fight.<ref name="TR" />
